sourceQuote: Objective This objective is to train students to be able to work as teachers teaching sciences, physics, chemistry, biology and other courses in middle and primary schools or to work in institutions of higher learning, research institutions as professional personnel in the fields of teaching, scientific research or administration.
targetQuote: 目标 培养 students 能够作为中学和小学的科学、物理、化学、生物等课程教师，或在高等教育机构、研究机构从事教学、科研或管理工作的专业人员。
